name: openbb_forex_historical
description:
Daily exchange-rate history for one currency pair through the OpenBB Platform (obb.currency.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, data_points, start_date, end_date, rates: [{date, open, high, low, close, ...}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (six-letter pair, upper-cased, e.g. EURUSD, GBPJPY, USDINR; default EURUSD); start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default 90 days ago); end_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today); provider (fmp, polygon, tiingo or yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Other sources: yf_forex_history, av_forex_daily; current rate: av_forex_rate. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "GBPJPY", "start_date": "2026-07-01", "end_date": "2026-09-30"}
